Back from late summer holidays, with the autumn equinox fast approaching. We had a week in Aarhus in late July, followed by a couple of weeks in the Netherlands and Switzerland at the end of August. It was very nice to take some time away and see some friends and family, and some mountains in Switzerland! (next month's post).

### Rainbow fisheye
